resources.string:
Nika is a screen reader for Android.

What's new in this version:
• Fixed the empty "Menu items order" screen: it now lists the items you switched on in the menu settings, you can move them up and down, and the menu follows that order.
• The agent has its own page without the word "script": settings, and folding "Permissions" and "Commands".
• The agent speaks the language of the phone and understands answers from Vivo (NVDACN) better.
• "Send feedback" lets you choose e-mail or Telegram.
• The talking clock is more exact.
Write to the developer in Telegram: report a problem or suggest an idea
